nodes.rationale: Per-word Control.Invoke starved input and AllCells auto-size made row adds O(n^2); search dropped from ~62s to under 2s.

nodes.label: IsWorthItCriteria / IsTooNoisy thresholds
nodes.rationale: Users tend to say Yes to everything, so noisy rules are left out to avoid burying real inconsistencies in false alarms; per-project medians set the bar.

nodes.norm_label: docker volume mount of local model (/app/model)
nodes.rationale: Loads a local fine-tuned model instead of downloading from HuggingFace, so builds are fast and model files stay on the host.

nodes.label: Multiple names per code (duplicate Ids)
nodes.rationale: 369 codes appear on more than one row with alternate names (e.g. zza: Dimili, Kirdki, Zaza, Zazaki...).

nodes.label: Two-letter 'hi' (Hindi) entry
nodes.rationale: The only non-3-letter Id; an ISO 639-1 code, apparently added by hand alongside the ISO 639-3 data.

nodes.label: Inverted_Name column
nodes.rationale: Sortable inverted form, e.g. 'Arabic, Algerian Saharan'.

nodes.label: ISO 639-3 language codes
nodes.rationale: 8336 of 8337 Id values are three-letter lowercase codes (aaa..zzj, 7930 distinct); layout matches the SIL ISO 639-3 Name Index table.

nodes.label: Macrolanguage entries
nodes.rationale: Names tagged '(macrolanguage)': doi, kok, msa, nep, ori, swa, zza.

nodes.label: Print_Name column
nodes.rationale: Natural-order display name, e.g. 'Algerian Saharan Arabic'.

nodes.label: Sign languages
nodes.rationale: 165 rows name a Sign Language (e.g. ads Adamorobe Sign Language).

nodes.label: Special-purpose codes (mis, mul, und, zxx)
nodes.rationale: Uncoded languages, Multiple languages, Undetermined, No linguistic content / Not applicable.

nodes.label: LangCodeToNameMap.txt
nodes.rationale: Tab-separated table (8337 data rows, 3 columns, header 'Id Print_Name Inverted_Name') mapping language codes to human-readable names. Embedded as a string resource in EcTranslators and used by the NLLB translator to show language names for codes (first occurrence per code wins).

nodes.label: ConverterSettings.cs
nodes.rationale: Holds an aEC field if the converter already exists so the activator can maintain a single tree of ConverterSettings items.

nodes.label: SettingsReader.cs
nodes.rationale: Reads ConverterSettings from XML files and sets aEC while checking each item against the EncConverters repository.

nodes.label: Delete (X) Toolbar Icon
nodes.rationale: Small dark-gray 'X' glyph on a transparent background, the standard toolbar/button icon for a delete or remove action in the AIGuesserEC UI.

nodes.label: Fill Down Toolbar Icon
nodes.description: Small 16x16 toolbar icon showing a white page/sheet with a blue downward-pointing arrow over it.
nodes.rationale: Toolbar button glyph for a 'fill down' style command in the BackTranslationHelper UI: it copies or applies content downward to the next rows or items.

nodes.label: Fill Up Toolbar Icon (blue up-arrow over page)
nodes.description: Tiny 16x16-style toolbar icon showing a blue upward-pointing arrow over a white document/page, in the Visual Studio image library 'HS' style.
nodes.norm_label: fill up toolbar icon (blue up-arrow over page)
nodes.rationale: Likely a BackTranslationHelper toolbar/button image for a 'fill up' action, such as copying or moving text upward into a field above
